title: PigGuardians
description:
The death of pigs will be avenged.
This mod will spawn piglin brutes when pigs are killed.
(Is done with scoreboard interaction detection, wich can interrupt your "pigs killed" in your statistics). This pack is just a little addon to vanilla.
body:
Wanted your pigs to be avenged on death?
Say no more!
But stay away if you also don't want to die.
This Mod will spawn Piglin brutes if a pig gets killed.
It is meant to be just a little addon for minecraft.
